info.title: ControlTower API
info.description: Trips broken down day by day: trips, items, places, day extras, trip log, the past trip record (reflection, item feedback, stats, favourites), and cover photos.

get.description: All trips, soonest first; undated trips last. Optionally filter by phase.

delete.description: Deletes the trip with its items, days, log entries, and cover photo. Places are kept.

get.description: Every local day of the trip with its items (and their role that day) and log.
A trip's items in time order (actual time if recorded); untimed items last.

schema.title: Response List Items Trips  Trip Id  Items Get
Response Create Item Trips  Trip Id  Items Post
Response Read Item Items  Item Id  Get

patch.description: Send `kind` plus only the fields to change; send null to clear an optional field.

schema.title: Response Update Item Items  Item Id  Patch

delete.description: Log entries that referenced the item are kept; their link is cleared.

get.description: Match `q` against name, city, or IATA code (case-insensitive).

delete.description: Items and log entries that used the place keep existing, without it.

get.description: Only days that have extras set.

schema.title: Response List Days Trips  Trip Id  Days Get

put.description: Create or replace a day's extras (fields left out are cleared).

schema.title: Response List Log Trips  Trip Id  Log Get

patch.description: Change only the fields sent; send null to clear an optional one.

get.description: 404 until I've reflected on the trip.

put.description: Create or replace my reflection: fields left out are cleared.

delete.description: Idempotent: deleting a reflection that doesn't exist is fine.

put.description: Replace my 👍/👎, ♥ and review. Returns null when that leaves nothing to keep.

schema.title: Response Put Feedback Items  Item Id  Feedback Put

get.description: Derived on every read: nights, cities, countries, flights, spend, season, feedback.

Items I ♥'d across all trips, most recent first (untimed last).

Filters: the place's country ("JP"), item kind, activity category ("food").

put.description: Set or replace the trip's cover photo. EXIF data (incl. GPS location) is removed.

delete.description: Remove the trip's cover photo (no-op if it has none); the cover falls back to teal.

get.description: One stored copy of a photo: sm (400px), md (1200px), or lg (2400px), longest edge.
